row.proto: void Career_Cancel_UpgradeDevelopment(void *upgrades, uint32_t owner, void *inst, uint32_t day)
row.notes: U-level development cancel (Upgrades, owner, instance, day): 0x143523e60 acts when the latest state is InProgress or InDevelopment or the latest entry's fitted byte (+9) is 3, and only an InProgress entry with a real owner must match owner (InDevelopment is not owner-checked); it sets +0x98/+0x9a to 0xffff and clears +0x9c..+0xab, pushes the most recent earlier state that is neither InProgress nor InDevelopment (Invalid if none) with the passed owner and clears fitted; in upgrades+8==2 mode it mirrors onto the same-id instances of the other owners whose latest state is InDevelopment only when the cancelled entry's dual flag (state entry +0xb) was 1; then availability refresh (modes 1,2; mode 0 sets +0x1aa8) and the upgrades-changed message. No RP; single caller 0x1412419d0 (wording: ce-verify-3 V0310)

verify.notes: V0242 proto ok, single caller 0x1412419d0 (which posts a BankTransactionMessage first); wrong: the sibling mirror is not unconditional in mode 2. Corrected: U-level development cancel (Upgrades, owner, instance, day): 0x143523e60 (only when the latest state is InProgress/InDevelopment and the owner matches) clears +0x98..+0xa8, pushes the most recent earlier state that is neither InProgress nor InDevelopment (Invalid if none) and clears fitted; in upgrades+8==2 mode it mirrors onto the same-id instances of the other owners only when the cancelled entry's dual flag (state entry +0xb) was 1; then availability refresh (modes 1,2; mode 0 sets +0x1aa8) and the upgrades-changed message. No RP

V0310 Proto (rcx,edx,r8,r9w day used as u16), dual flag +0xb read before the cancel, mode-2 mirror only when it was 1 (onto other owners' same-id instances whose latest state is InDevelopment), refresh modes 1,2 / mode 0 +0x1aa8, bus msg, single caller 0x1412419d0 check. Wrong: 0x143523e60 is not limited to InProgress/InDevelopment and does not owner-check InDevelopment (0x143523e9d: the owner compare runs only when the latest state is 2 and its owner is not 0x1460fc2b0; 0x143523ecb: also acts when the latest entry's fitted byte +9 == 3). Corrected: U-level development cancel (Upgrades, owner, instance, day): 0x143523e60 acts when the latest state is InProgress or InDevelopment or the latest entry's fitted byte (+9) is 3, and only an InProgress entry with a real owner must match owner (InDevelopment is not owner-checked); it sets +0x98/+0x9a to 0xffff and clears +0x9c..+0xab, pushes the most recent earlier state that is neither InProgress nor InDevelopment (Invalid if none) with the passed owner and clears fitted; in upgrades+8==2 mode it mirrors onto the same-id instances of the other owners whose latest state is InDevelopment only when the cancelled entry's dual flag (state entry +0xb) was 1; then availability refresh (modes 1,2; mode 0 sets +0x1aa8) and the upgrades-changed message. No RP; single caller 0x1412419d0

V0874 sigcheck OK; proto (rcx upgrades, edx owner, r8 inst, r9 day used as u16) right; single caller 0x141241b17. 0x143523e60: acts on latest state 2 or 7 or fitted byte (end-7) == 3; owner compare only when the latest state is 2 and its owner is not 0x1460fc2b0; pushes the last earlier state that is neither 2 nor 7 (5 Invalid if none) with the passed owner, then Career_Set_UpgradeFitted(..,0,..). Dual flag = latest entry +0xb read before the cancel; mode-2 mirror over the two instance lists (+0x110/+0xd10, +0xd50/+0x1950) by id +0x58 onto other owners when that instance's latest state is 7; refresh in modes 1,2, mode 0 writes +0x1aa8 = 0x3fff0000. Quibbles: the rollback writes qword +0x98 = 0xffffffff, byte +0xa0 and qword +0xa4, so +0xa1..+0xa3 are untouched (clears +0x9c..+0xa0 and +0xa4..+0xab); the posted message (vt 0x14584e360) is named recommended_upgrade_message
